title: The same ship?
relationship: Coastal watch is the umbrella: observation picture, delivery history, source comparison and identity inquiry are linked views.

rehearsal.identifiers: All MMSI, IMO and callsign values in the rehearsal are invented and must not be looked up as real subjects.
rehearsal.position: Invented east/north metre plane; no real coast or ship.
rehearsal.sourceGraph: Authored dependencies, not inferred from a live feed.
rehearsal.assumptions: A shared westward GNSS correction moves all descendants in the comparison only. GNSS allowance is adjustable; radar allowance is a fixed illustrative 35 m. No calibrated covariance or probability.
rehearsal.identity: Append-only analyst hypothesis revisions. Names and reported identifiers are claims; source records remain immutable. Radar association is always unverified.

reuse.implementation: Direct import of transportPicture for the real transport snapshot inspector.
Identity vocabulary and distinct location/metadata epochs inform the public model; no private implementation copied.
Shared AIS lineage and explicit clock/association boundaries inform the rehearsal.

transport.input: Existing Coastal watch JSON export or one manual GET /api/coastal/state on a loopback host.
transport.limits: 2 MB input; 200 observations; 400 station acceptances; 5000 receipts. Only required fields are projected and displayed as text.
transport.authenticity: Unsigned and unverified; imported hash is not presented as authentication.
transport.identity: MMSI grouping only. Missing name, IMO, registry and GNSS lineage remain unknown.
transport.separation: Actual transport records never enter the fictional rehearsal or acquire its invented dependencies.
